datafield.subfield: Letterpress printed with an unusual structure of tabbed paper pockets designed to resemble cassette tapes. Set in ClarendonLTStd-Light.

"As a child, my sister and I would play incessantly with our father's collection of cassette tapes, many times until the tapes unravelled to the point of no return. But, even though some of the tapes got destroyed, the songs on them played in my head over and over. And, as I've gotten older, I've realised that things people have said to me do the same thing-- play over and over in my head. This book is based on that idea and is designed with the motif of a cassette tape in mind." Artist's statement from the colophon.
Artist's book by SCAD Advertising student Danielle McCoy. How to Be was awarded second prize in the 7th Annual Student Artist's Book Juried Competition by Juror Elizabeth Lide.
